Readings of the Ecumenical Patriarchate lectionary, verified weekly against Φωνὴ Κυρίου (Ἀποστολικὴ Διακονία τῆς Ἐκκλησίας τῆς Ἑλλάδος).
Greek of the homilies: Migne, Patrologia Graeca, from the Ψηφιακὴ Πατρολογία digitization (University of the Aegean). Epistle Greek: Byzantine text.
English: rendered in Clear English from the public-domain NPNF translation (Chrysostom) and Mary H. Allies, 1898 (St John of Damascus). Typeface: GFS Didot (Greek Font Society, OFL).
Mosaics of Hagia Sophia: the Theotokos and Child (apse, 867) and Christ Pantocrator (Deesis, 13th c.); the Transfiguration (apse, St Catherine's, Sinai, 6th c.) — photographs by Myrabella, Wikimedia Commons, public domain.
